Both cops need to be fired and arrested but we all know nothing will happen at all. We don’t get justice, we don’t get “I’m sorry”. We get accused and we get murdered this world we live in never will change. 
#ICantBreathe #BlackLivesMatter #SayHisName

How come #AllLivesMatter only trends when #BlackLivesMatter does? It’s like y’all only bring it up coincidentally when we are trying to fight and speak up for black lives. Then you come to Twitter pretending like you’re not trying to silence the movement.
